summary: The PR removes unnecessary post_init signal handling for ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set, which could lead to performance improvements. However, there are concerns about potential behavioral regressions and maintainability.

issues.description: Removing the post_init signal handler might break existing behavior for users who rely on this signal for other purposes, even if width_field and height_field are not set.
The code becomes slightly less readable due to the conditional check for width_field and height_field within the post_init connection logic.
